objective: Give developers repeatable local and CI evidence for core progression and save safety, with green regressions for F1-F3.

include: Pinned minimal Node/package/lockfile setup and real-script deterministic rule tests
Core progression, purchase, reset, save/import/export, naming and offline-boundary coverage
Isolated Chromium/Playwright journeys against the actual locally served page
Bounded F1 invalid-import/autosave/tick-safety, F2 offline-time and F3 prompt-cancellation corrections
CI using the same commands, failure artifacts, test-local matching Vue asset and existing permitted capacity
Narrow test seams and updates to current development guidance
exclude: Broad layer/global-state restructuring, new state frameworks and TypeScript conversion
Vue migration, balancing, new game content and unrelated bug fixes
Broad save-format migration or changing layer IDs, save key, licenses or Decimal semantics
Branch-protection/ruleset changes, runner provisioning, paid services, deployment and automatic merge

acceptance_criteria: TST01-AC01: A clean checkout can install locked dependencies with `npm ci` and run documented syntax, rule-test and browser-test commands on Windows and the selected CI runner. Runtime/browser/dependency versions are pinned and setup prerequisites and expected exits are documented in the existing guide.

TST01-AC02: Tests exercise the shipped Decimal implementation and game functions with a controllable clock, timers and isolated storage; each test gets fresh state. No test reads real browser saves, uses live user data, waits on real time for game progression, or leaves timers/servers/browser contexts running.

TST01-AC03: Rule tests cover fresh initialization; first prestige and reset effects; locked, insufficient-funds, valid and repeated upgrade purchases; tick progression; and save/load plus export/import round-trips retaining representative large Decimal values, upgrades, milestones and multiple saves.

TST01-AC04: Import tests cover invalid base64/JSON, invalid nested shapes, valid current-format saves, foreign-mod confirmation denial, cancellation and storage-write failure. Rejection preserves active and durable valid progress, reports a recoverable error and prevents invalid autosave. A failed tick cannot leave the runtime falsely marked as actively ticking; error handling must not silently resume unsafe mutations. Valid imports remain usable after reload.

TST01-AC05: Clock tests cover no elapsed time, backwards clock movement, below/at/above the configured offline cap, offline production disabled and repeated catch-up ticks. All elapsed-time inputs use documented units. The one-hour case caps accumulated time at 3,600 seconds before consumption and does not grant excess or duplicate progression.

TST01-AC06: Save-menu tests cover cancelling New Save and Rename, empty, reserved, duplicate and overlength names. Cancellation changes neither active selection nor save contents and throws no error; rejected names create no partial save. Valid creation, rename and selection persist after reload.

TST01-AC07: Chromium journeys verify page startup without unexpected console errors; prestige → upgrade → progression; save/reload; successful and rejected import with retained progress and visible recovery feedback; and cancelled New Save/Rename. Browser assertions inspect rendered controls and durable state, rather than only calling global functions. Changed recovery feedback is readable and keyboard-operable. Other browser engines and full late-game balance remain explicitly unverified, rather than implied by a Chromium pass.

TST01-AC08: CI runs syntax checks, rule tests and the required Chromium journeys with read-only repository permissions and no application secrets or deployment steps. A failing required test makes the job fail. Failures retain bounded reports/traces/screenshots with synthetic data. Tests use a pinned local Vue asset matching the shipped version and avoid CDN availability as a test dependency; this does not claim that the shipped game works offline.

TST01-AC09: Final required checks are green with no skipped, focused-only, expected-failure or retry-masked cases for the acceptance paths. F1–F3 each have recorded failing-baseline/passing-fixed evidence, using isolated safe fixtures or immutable baseline checkouts. Test sensitivity is shown by a controlled temporary regression/mutation for save preservation and the offline cap; no broken application changes are left in the deliverable.

TST01-AC10: The implementation PR maps each criterion to exact tests and fresh results at its head/base, documents commands and remaining limits, retains upstream licenses and existing valid saves, and passes a final source/diff review. No milestone acceptance, merge or release is inferred from green tests.
constraints: Follow AGENTS.md and freshly verified Orcha main standards
The current request authorizes milestone documentation only; implementation_authorization remains null
Preserve existing lifecycle mode and writer protection; no enrollment or fabricated stage receipts
Use synthetic saves and disposable contexts; protect recoverable original data on failure
Required criteria cannot be skipped, expected-failed, focused-only or masked by retries
Do not infer actual-user usability, other browser engines or late-game correctness from a synthetic/Chromium pass

decisions.question: How should rule tests reuse this script-based engine?
decisions.answer: Use the Node test runner with a controlled runtime that executes the shipped script graph and Decimal library.
decisions.rationale: The baseline has no test framework; the review demonstrated a small actual-script harness can exercise real game functions without a production architecture rewrite.

decisions.question: What initial browser scope gives executable UI coverage?
decisions.answer: Use Playwright with Chromium and isolated synthetic saves; pin tool versions during preparation and record other engines as unverified.
decisions.rationale: The shipped UI is Vue/browser based; a single real browser journey closes the rendering/control gap left by VM probes while keeping initial scope bounded.

owner_origin.request: Write a milestone to implement testing.
owner_origin.scope: Milestone specification and matching planning artifact only

standards.purpose: Observed planning-run evidence, not a consumer version pin

source_context.registry_observation: Orcha dev registry includes step3software/Prestige-Tree, source master, aliases prestige-tree and prestige

baseline_evidence.syntax: All 13 shipped scripts passed Node syntax checks in preceding read-only review
failures: F1 invalid p:null import replaced active state, broke ticking and was autosaved
F2 one-hour setting retained 6480 of 7200 offline seconds after first tick
F3 cancelled New Save threw on null.replace
baseline_evidence.limitations: Browser DOM was stubbed and storage was in-memory; these are prior diagnostics, not the delivered suite

documentation_assessment.organization: README -> AGENTS/manifest -> existing developer guide; engine index for feature-specific reference
strengths: Single current development guide and canonical repository manifest
Explicit separation of game reward milestones from delivery specifications
defects: No durable test commands/CI before implementation; historical engine tutorials retain old paths/setup semantics
documentation_assessment.planned_repair: Update the existing development guide with installed test commands and limits; README links this one source milestone; no second test guide or status ledger
documentation_assessment.measurement: Qualitative navigation assessment; no timing/token-efficiency claim

verification_strategy.rule_tests: Deterministic real-script/Decimal tests with isolated state and clock/storage/timer adapters
verification_strategy.browser_tests: Actual locally served page with rendered-control journeys, synthetic saves and pinned test-local Vue
verification_strategy.sensitivity: Failing baseline then passing fixed F1-F3; controlled temporary save-preservation and offline-cap regressions
verification_strategy.ci: Same required suites on PR/push; deliberate test failure blocks job; no deployment or account-policy edits
verification_strategy.current_status: Planned; application implementation and its acceptance checks have not run

preparation_prerequisites: Fresh source and writer scope; exact file-level handoff
Pinned supported Node, Playwright/browser and matching test-local Vue versions
Repository write access and existing permitted CI capacity; no runner provisioning
risks: CDN or CI availability hides product failures
